verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a password and secrets platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented user-definable rule or trigger-action feature. The Events API only lets you retrieve activity data to send to a SIEM, which is a developer building block. Watchtower's breach and weak-password alerts are fixed built-in checks, not user-defined rules, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
